### A Few Good Men
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/a-few-good-men-one-year-devotions-for-men-january-5.html
Passage: Isaiah 4:2
Points:
- Catastrophic war stripped Jerusalem of its men, leaving behind desperate survival and grief.
- Isaiah pointed beyond immediate ruin to future renewal through the Messiah, the Branch of the Lord.
- God intended for the surviving remnant to be cleansed and consecrated rather than merely resume ordinary life.
- Devastating trials can serve a redemptive purpose by purging sin, strengthening faith, and preparing believers for divine blessing.

### The LORD's Glorious Branch
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/lords-glorious-branch
Passage: Isaiah 4:2-6
Points:
- The Day of the Lord executes righteous judgment on evil while bringing restoration to God's surviving remnant.
- The beautiful and glorious Branch foreshadows the Messiah as the true righteous representative of God's people.
- God purges the remnant from moral defilement, declaring them holy and restoring spiritual fruitfulness.
- Echoing the wilderness cloud and fire, the Lord provides His people with His divine presence as a canopy and refuge.
- The present age extends grace through the gospel, urging everyone to be clothed in Christ's righteousness before the final judgment.
